name: io.github.ni-c/freshrss-mcp
title: FreshRSS
description: MCP server for FreshRSS, the self-hosted RSS feed aggregator

environmentVariables.name: FRESHRSS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Root URL of the FreshRSS instance, e.g. https://rss.example.com

environmentVariables.name: FRESHRSS_API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: API password from Settings -> Profile -> API management, not the web login password

environmentVariables.name: FRESHRSS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools

environmentVariables.name: FRESHRSS_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate for this connection only
